newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian weekly forex demand rises to $71.164 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian weekly forex demand rises to $71.164 mln.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Thursday it sold $71.164 million at a rate of 85 naira to the dollar at its weekly auction this week.
Last week the bank sold $62.26 million at the same rate.
Dealers said the increase in demand showed a 5.88 percent devaluation of the naira last month had failed to dampen the appetite for forex.

They said the central bank's request that banks should provide details of forex end-users so as to stem capital flight and speculative buying had also succeeded in reducing demand for forex at the weekly auction.
